title: Additive manufacturing of metastructures at the micro- and nano-scale
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01054J, Review Article
Shiqi Hu, Cherry Park, Sebin Jeong, Nara Jeon, Ji Tae Kim, Junsuk Rho
Additive manufacturing including nozzle-, light-, and aerosol-based, reshapes micro/nanoscale metastructures. We link materials and printing routes to device functions, highlight optical and active uses, and discuss challenges and opportunities.
